purpose: CPU-runnable, deterministic CMF integration fixture for the experimental Ollama/Cortiq adapter. It is a complete generative model, not a skill or decision file.

validation.manual: Verified locally on 2026-10-16 through the pinned v0.8.19 darwin/arm64 release archive: cortiq serve, GET /healthz, POST /v1/completions, and non-stream POST /v1/chat/completions all succeeded.
validation.ci: The unprivileged Verify CMF candidate inputs workflow verifies the artifact hash and runs this fixture through the pinned linux/amd64 release binary via cmfrunner's adapter E2E test.

updatePolicy: This artifact is never regenerated by release intake. Any CMF runtime tag change must consciously regenerate, review, hash, and validate a matching fixture before its candidate lock can pass CI.
